rationale: The answer abstains and shows the CAPEC query, but it states none of the five expected alternate names for CAPEC patterns corresponding to T1557: Man-in-the-Middle / MITM, Monkey-in-the-Middle, Monster-in-the-Middle, On-path Attacker, and Person-in-the-Middle / PiTM. Its zero-record claims are supported by the traces, though the attack sub-question was skipped because of a reversed dependency, so the abstention is not fully justified. The only unsupported identifiers are the examples T1566, M1017, and CAPEC-98.
